overview_description.description: VBooking is a travel technology and software company that develops AI-based platforms and operational tools for businesses in the travel, tourism, and hospitality sectors, including travel agencies, online travel agencies (OTAs), destination management companies (DMCs), tour operators, and accommodation providers. Its platform includes booking engines, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, quotation and itinerary tools, inventory management, payment integrations, live booking support, analytics, and automation workflows.
